description:
Title: Luxury Airplane

You produce airplanes.
While the base model is always the same, your customer likes to pimp their airplane with fancy interior.
You let them decide between a number of 5 different bars, the number of seats, their color, and the amount of water in the toilets of their plane (you can come up with additional stuff).
After you received the specifications you send the requirements to different teams to manufacture the parts.
E.g. manufacturing the vodka bar is done by the Russian team, the whiskey bar is manufactured by an Irish team.
After receiving the individual bits and pieces, the interior of the plane is assembled, and the plane is sent on a test flight.
During the flight you create a test protocol which is sent to you and the customer.
The plane is delivered to the customer, which has to confirm.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_LuxuryAirplane" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/luxury-airplane">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Options" name="Configuration options"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Specifications" name="Customer specifications"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RequirementsRussian" name="Requirements for vodka bar"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RequirementsIrish" name="Requirements for whiskey bar"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RequirementsOtherBar" name="Requirements for other bar"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RequirementsOtherParts" name="Requirements for seats, color and toilet water"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_VodkaBarDelivered" name="Vodka bar delivered"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_WhiskeyBarDelivered" name="Whiskey bar delivered"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_OtherBarDelivered" name="Other bar delivered"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_OtherPartsDelivered" name="Seats, color and toilet water delivered"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_TestProtocol" name="Test protocol"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Airplane" name="Airplane delivery"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Delivery confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LuxuryAirplane">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Manufacturer" name="Airplane Manufacturer" processRef="Process_Manufacturer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Russian" name="Russian Team"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Irish" name="Irish Team"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OtherTeams" name="Other Part Manufacturing Teams"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Options" name="Send configuration options" sourceRef="Task_SendOptions" targetRef="StartEvent_OptionsReceived" messageRef="Msg_Options"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Specifications" name="Send specifications" sourceRef="Task_SendSpecifications" targetRef="Catch_SpecificationsReceived" messageRef="Msg_Specifications"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RequirementsRussian" name="Send requirements" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirementsRussian" targetRef="Participant_Russian" messageRef="Msg_RequirementsRussian"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RequirementsIrish" name="Send requirements" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirementsIrish" targetRef="Participant_Irish" messageRef="Msg_RequirementsIrish"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RequirementsOtherBar" name="Send requirements" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirementsOtherBar" targetRef="Participant_OtherTeams" messageRef="Msg_RequirementsOtherBar"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RequirementsOtherParts" name="Send requirements" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirementsOtherParts" targetRef="Participant_OtherTeams" messageRef="Msg_RequirementsOtherParts"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_VodkaBarDelivered" name="Deliver vodka bar" sourceRef="Participant_Russian" targetRef="Catch_VodkaBarReceived" messageRef="Msg_VodkaBarDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_WhiskeyBarDelivered" name="Deliver whiskey bar" sourceRef="Participant_Irish" targetRef="Catch_WhiskeyBarReceived" messageRef="Msg_WhiskeyBarDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OtherBarDelivered" name="Deliver other bar" sourceRef="Participant_OtherTeams" targetRef="Catch_OtherBarReceived" messageRef="Msg_OtherBarDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OtherPartsDelivered" name="Deliver seats, color and toilet water" sourceRef="Participant_OtherTeams" targetRef="Catch_OtherPartsReceived" messageRef="Msg_OtherPartsDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_TestProtocol" name="Send test protocol" sourceRef="Task_SendTestProtocol" targetRef="Catch_TestProtocolReceived" messageRef="Msg_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Airplane" name="Deliver airplane" sourceRef="Task_DeliverAirplane" targetRef="Catch_AirplaneReceived" messageRef="Msg_Airplane"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Confirm delivery" sourceRef="Task_SendDeliveryConfirmation" targetRef="Catch_DeliveryConfirmed" messageRef="Msg_DeliveryConfirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Manufacturer" name="Luxury Airplane Production" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Configuration" name="Configuration offer started"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOptions" name="Send configuration options to customer"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_SpecificationsReceived" name="Specifications received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_SpecificationsReceived" messageRef="Msg_Specifications"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_SplitRequirements" name="Split requirements"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BarChoice" name="Which bar?"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequirementsRussian" name="Send requirements to Russian team"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequirementsIrish" name="Send requirements to Irish team"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequirementsOtherBar" name="Send requirements for other bar to other teams"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequirementsOtherParts" name="Send requirements for seats, color and toilet water to other teams"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_VodkaBarReceived" name="Vodka bar received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_VodkaBarReceived" messageRef="Msg_VodkaBarDelivered"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_WhiskeyBarReceived" name="Whiskey bar received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_WhiskeyBarReceived" messageRef="Msg_WhiskeyBarDelivered"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_OtherBarReceived" name="Other bar received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OtherBarReceived" messageRef="Msg_OtherBarDelivered"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_OtherPartsReceived" name="Seats, color and toilet water received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OtherPartsReceived" messageRef="Msg_OtherPartsDelivered"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BarMerge" name="Bar received"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PartsJoin" name="All parts received"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleInterior" name="Assemble interior"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductTestFlight" name="Conduct test flight"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateTestProtocol" name="Create test protocol during flight"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTestProtocol" name="Send test protocol to customer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DeliverAirplane" name="Deliver airplane to customer"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_DeliveryConfirmed" name="Delivery confirmed by customer">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DeliveryConfirmed" messageRef="Msg_DeliveryConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Delivered" name="Airplane delivered and confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Configuration" targetRef="Task_SendOptions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_SendOptions" targetRef="Catch_SpecificationsReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Catch_SpecificationsReceived" targetRef="Gateway_SplitRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_SplitRequirements" targetRef="Gateway_BarChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_SplitRequirements" targetRef="Task_SendRequirementsOtherParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" name="Vodka bar" sourceRef="Gateway_BarChoice" targetRef="Task_SendRequirementsRussian"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" name="Whiskey bar" sourceRef="Gateway_BarChoice" targetRef="Task_SendRequirementsIrish"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" name="Other bar" sourceRef="Gateway_BarChoice" targetRef="Task_SendRequirementsOtherBar"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirementsRussian" targetRef="Catch_VodkaBarReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirementsIrish" targetRef="Catch_WhiskeyBarReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirementsOtherBar" targetRef="Catch_OtherBarReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Catch_VodkaBarReceived" targetRef="Gateway_BarMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Catch_WhiskeyBarReceived" targetRef="Gateway_BarMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Catch_OtherBarReceived" targetRef="Gateway_BarMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_BarMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PartsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirementsOtherParts" targetRef="Catch_OtherPartsReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Catch_OtherPartsReceived" targetRef="Gateway_PartsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsJoin" targetRef="Task_AssembleInterior"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_AssembleInterior" targetRef="Task_ConductTestFlight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_ConductTestFlight" targetRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol" targetRef="Task_SendTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_SendTestProtocol" targetRef="Task_DeliverAirplane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_DeliverAirplane" targetRef="Catch_DeliveryConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Catch_DeliveryConfirmed" targetRef="EndEvent_Delivered"/>

  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OptionsReceived" name="Configuration options received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OptionsReceived" messageRef="Msg_Options"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseBar" name="Choose bar"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseSeats" name="Choose number of seats"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseColor" name="Choose color"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseWater" name="Choose amount of water in toilets"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSpecifications" name="Send specifications to manufacturer"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_TestProtocolReceived" name="Test protocol received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_TestProtocolReceived" messageRef="Msg_TestProtocol"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_AirplaneReceived" name="Airplane received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_AirplaneReceived" messageRef="Msg_Airplane"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConfirmDelivery" name="Confirm delivery"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDeliveryConfirmation" name="Send delivery confirmation"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Confirmed" name="Delivery confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_OptionsReceived" targetRef="Task_ChooseBar"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_02" sourceRef="Task_ChooseBar" targetRef="Task_ChooseSeats"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_03" sourceRef="Task_ChooseSeats" targetRef="Task_ChooseColor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_04" sourceRef="Task_ChooseColor" targetRef="Task_ChooseWater"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_05" sourceRef="Task_ChooseWater" targetRef="Task_SendSpecifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_06" sourceRef="Task_SendSpecifications" targetRef="Catch_TestProtocolReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_07" sourceRef="Catch_TestProtocolReceived" targetRef="Catch_AirplaneReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_08" sourceRef="Catch_AirplaneReceived" targetRef="Task_ConfirmDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_09" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmDelivery" targetRef="Task_SendDeliveryConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_10" sourceRef="Task_SendDeliveryConfirmation" targetRef="EndEvent_Confirmed"/>

  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
